category: game L4 reverse proxy (Minecraft and generic TCP/UDP)

free_tier.stated: The first Minecraft Java server on the default worldwide region is free: up to 20 players at once.

egress.terms: No byte allowance is stated for the free server or for the paid lines; prices are per month by protocol, from USD 5 for Minecraft Bedrock and from USD 7 for other UDP; ingress: tcp

interface_detail: Wizard that shows the total before you connect, billed from an account balance.
chaining: Fronts a public origin per protocol; the free server is a Minecraft Java endpoint only.

limits.value: free covers 'One Minecraft Java server in the default worldwide region on the Start plan'; Bedrock and other UDP are separate paid lines
free server is capped at 20 players at once

binding_note: The free entitlement is one Java server with no stated byte counter, and UDP is a paid line item, so nothing free reaches a 1 TiB/month quota. The paid 'Other UDP' line is explicitly 'Not for VPNs or proxies', which is the relevant limit for a WireGuard use.

identity_cost.detail: An account with a balance; support runs through Telegram. The signup form was not opened.

reliability_note: Free server is one Java server at 20 players; generic UDP is sold with an explicit exclusion of VPN and proxy traffic.
confidence_note: Free entitlement, price list and the per-protocol caveat are on one first-party page. Whether the free server has an unpublished fair-use cap would need an account.

evidence.proved: Free: one Minecraft Java server in the default worldwide region on the Start plan, up to 20 players at once, no charges
